The decisive mistake was made by Reviews_Expert at step 7. After the scraping failed, it stopped using real data and produced "manually collected" figures (review counts, ratings, and accessibility mention counts) without actually visiting any pages. These numbers were fabricated. It also chose the wrong trails (Mist Trail, Vernal and Nevada Falls, Upper Yosemite Falls) and missed the wheelchair-accessible ones, Yosemite Falls (lower) and Bridalveil Fall. It then concluded the task, so the final answer was wrong.
